newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: AMS surges six percent in limp Vienna.
newsitem.headline: AMS surges six percent in limp Vienna.

text.p: Shares in Austria's leading manufacturer of semiconductors, Austria Mikro Systeme AG, soared over six percent in an overall depressed Vienna market on Tuesday.
At 1004 GMT, AMS was up 56 schillings -- or 6.72 percent-- to 888, while the blue-chip ATX index was down 0.26 percent.
Traders said it seems that investors are taking the view that AMS is well on its way to turning around its two loss-making acquisitions, made last year.
Traders also linked the buying to the fact that AMS has recently underperformed international semiconductor indices.
AMS reported a group pretax loss of 3.1 million schillings for the first six months due to losses whipped up at its two subsidiaries SAMES and Thesys.
